recipe_version.title: Greek Gemista: Herb-and-Rice Stuffed Tomatoes and Peppers
recipe_version.description: Big tomatoes and bell peppers hollowed out and filled with rice simmered in their own tomato pulp with onion, garlic, parsley, mint, and oregano, then slow-baked with olive oil and potato wedges until the vegetables slump, the rice is tender, and the tops and potatoes are caramelized.

ingredients.name: beefsteak tomatoes
ingredients.preparation: tops cut off and kept, pulp scooped out and grated

ingredients.name: bell peppers
ingredients.display_name: red, yellow, or green bell peppers
ingredients.preparation: tops cut off and kept, seeds removed

ingredients.name: extra-virgin olive oil
ingredients.note: 3 tbsp filling, 5 tbsp pan and tops

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1 1/2 tsp filling, 1/2 tsp inside the vegetables, 1/2 tsp potatoes

steps.title: Preheat and hollow
steps.body: Turn the oven on to 375 F to preheat with a rack in the lower-middle position. Cut the tops off the tomatoes and peppers and keep them as lids. Scoop the tomato pulp into a bowl, leaving 1/4-inch walls, and grate or finely chop the pulp. Seed the peppers. Sprinkle the insides of all 8 vegetables with 1/2 tsp salt and set them in the roasting pan. Grate the onion, mince the garlic, and chop the parsley and mint.

steps.title: Cook the filling base
steps.body: Heat 3 tbsp olive oil in a 10-inch skillet over medium. Cook the onion until soft, 4 minutes; add the garlic for 1 minute.

steps.title: Simmer the rice
steps.body: Add the rice, tomato paste, tomato pulp, sugar, oregano, 1 1/2 tsp salt, and the pepper. Simmer, stirring, 7 minutes, until the rice is partly softened and has absorbed some juice (it finishes in the oven). Stir in the parsley and mint. While it simmers, toss the potato wedges with 2 tbsp olive oil and 1/2 tsp salt and tuck them between the vegetables (overlap stated).

steps.title: Fill
steps.body: Spoon the filling into the vegetables to about 3/4 full, spooning in any juices so the rice sits in liquid. Replace the lids, pour 1 cup water into the pan around the vegetables, and drizzle the remaining 3 tbsp olive oil over the tops.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Cover the pan with foil and bake in the preheated 375 F oven 40 minutes. Uncover, baste the tops with pan juices, and bake 25 minutes more, until the rice is fully tender, the vegetables slump, and the tops and potatoes are browned.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.body: Rest 5 minutes, then serve 2 stuffed vegetables per person with potatoes and a spoonful of pan juices.

components.name: stuffed tomatoes and peppers with potatoes
